test.create_query: CREATE TABLE perf_substring_off (p UInt8, id UInt64, s String, INDEX ix s TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha) GRANULARITY 1) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id SETTINGS max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1

CREATE TABLE perf_substring_on (p UInt8, id UInt64, s String, INDEX ix s TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha, substring_index = 1) GRANULARITY 1) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id SETTINGS max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, allow_experimental_text_index_substring_index = 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO perf_substring_off SELECT intDiv(number, 62500), number, concat(arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> concat('u', lower(hex(cityHash64(number, i)))), range(8)), ' '), if(number = 7, ' needle', '')) FROM numbers(2000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 8
INSERT INTO perf_substring_on SELECT * FROM perf_substring_off SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 8
